newsitem.title: USA: Florida waters searched for missing crewman.
newsitem.headline: Florida waters searched for missing crewman.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard searched the waters of the Atlantic Ocean off Florida on Wednesday for a Filipino crewman who went missing from a Panamanian freighter.

Randy Ejorcadas, 28, was last seen on Tuesday evening on the 600-foot (183-meter) Anna Z as it headed from West Palm Beach, Florida to New Orleans, the Coast Guard said. His hometown in the Philippines was not known.
"He was nowhere on the vessel," Coast Guard petty officer Veronica Bandrowsky said. "We are searching the water."

Three helicopters and two ships were searching a 113-mile (181-km) stretch of ocean from West Palm Beach to Key Largo, Florida, Bandrowsky said. The ship was at least 15 miles (24 km) off the coast when the crewman went missing.
